customer_profiles_phone_sealed.name: customer_profiles_phone_sealed
customer_profiles_phone_sealed.value: ("customer_profiles"."phone_enc" IS NULL) = ("customer_profiles"."phone_key_id" IS NULL) AND ("customer_profiles"."phone_enc" IS NULL) = ("customer_profiles"."phone_hash" IS NULL)

customer_profiles_birthday_valid.name: customer_profiles_birthday_valid
customer_profiles_birthday_valid.value: ("customer_profiles"."birthday_day" IS NULL AND "customer_profiles"."birthday_month" IS NULL) OR ("customer_profiles"."birthday_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "customer_profiles"."birthday_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12)

outbox_replay_idx.name: outbox_replay_idx
outbox_replay_idx.where: "outbox"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "outbox"."failed_at" IS NULL

outbox_finished_idx.name: outbox_finished_idx
outbox_finished_idx.where: "outbox"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL OR "outbox"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL

outbox_completed_after_dispatch.name: outbox_completed_after_dispatch
outbox_completed_after_dispatch.value: "outbox"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "outbox"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL

loyalty_programs_earn_rate_range.name: loyalty_programs_earn_rate_range
loyalty_programs_earn_rate_range.value: ("loyalty_programs"."earn_mode" = 'per_visit' AND "loyalty_programs"."earn_rate" BETWEEN 1 AND 500) OR ("loyalty_programs"."earn_mode" = 'per_pound' AND "loyalty_programs"."earn_rate" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

loyalty_programs_streak_shape.name: loyalty_programs_streak_shape
loyalty_programs_streak_shape.value: "loyalty_programs"."streak" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("loyalty_programs"."streak"->'bonusGold') = 'number' AND ("loyalty_programs"."streak"->>'bonusGold')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

ledger_entries_points_by_type.name: ledger_entries_points_by_type
ledger_entries_points_by_type.value:
CASE "ledger_entries"."type"
        WHEN 'earn' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" > 0
        WHEN 'bonus_streak' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" > 0
        WHEN 'bonus_referral' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" > 0
        WHEN 'bonus_game' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" > 0
        WHEN 'redeem' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" = 0
        WHEN 'reversal' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" < 0
        WHEN 'expiry' THEN "ledger_entries"."points" < 0
        ELSE "ledger_entries"."points" <> 0 END
